meta.title: Site lessons that are not White Rose small steps (Awsaj CCSS builds and any other non-WRM lesson), from the school curriculum site
meta.generatedBy: node tests/scripts/ws-wrm-extract.cjs --site <awsajacademymath/index.html> (writes wrm-steps.json and this file)
meta.source: School curriculum site https://timjmills.github.io/awsajacademymath/: PACING (weeks, tracks, st.f flags), CURRICULUM (domain, unit, note, enrich = Support lists)
meta.idFormat: <school grade id>|-|<title slug>: the site's own tracker key for a lesson with no WRM block/step (trkRow/trkTk in the site: slug = title lower-cased with every run of non [a-z0-9] removed). Example: G4|-|lineplotswithfractions (Grade 4 "Line plots with fractions"). Stable while the site keeps the title; a retitle on the site is a new id (the old one disappears from this file, which a --check run reports).
meta.grades: school grade ids: PK, K, G1 ... G5; wrmYear = the WRM year taught in that grade (PK = R, K = Y1, G1 = Y2 ... G5 = Y6)

flags.committee: site label "CCSS custom - build required": an Awsaj-authored lesson that closes a CCSS standard White Rose does not teach (pacing st.f "committee", st.s "SUP" = supplement). Not a WRM small step.
flags.enrich-native: site label "Support": an earlier year's WRM step listed as support in a later grade. These ARE WRM steps: they are recorded on the step (wrm-steps.json steps[].site.supportIn), and only a Support title that matches no WRM step would be listed here.
flags.non-ccss: site label "Non-CCSS extra": a WRM step with no CCSS code (wrm-steps.json step.flag)
flags.other: a pacing entry with no block, step or flag (G5 end-of-year: consolidation, investigation projects, problem solving, reasoning tasks)
flags.above: site label "Above grade": a WRM step whose CCSS is above the school grade (wrm-steps.json step.flag)

fields.title: the site title
fields.ccss: CCSS codes from the site, primary first
fields.ee: Wisconsin EE linked to them in data/standards/ccss-math.json
fields.unit: site curriculum unit name (e.g. "Awsaj supplement lessons (domain tests)")
fields.paceUnit: the pacing unit whose week range holds firstWeek: {key, name}
fields.block: the WRM block the pacing places it in (Y5.B14), or null
fields.firstWeek: first school week it is scheduled on any track (W01..), null when listed in the curriculum only

meta.assessments: domain exams and MAP windows from the pacing (st.f "exam" / "map"): not lessons, listed so nothing on the site is unaccounted for
